Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.

Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Activate Pharika by paying {B}{G} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snake, adding {C}{C}.
When the Snake dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
1806-2034-4871-7413.notes: You want to add different types of mana in steps 3 and 7 (one trigger adding {B} and the other adding {G}) to pay for Pharika's ability.

Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

1640-3011-7186.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.

2440-3581-4885-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

Repeat from step 3.

Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.

You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.

When the creature is unblocked, activate Phage's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Phage onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Phage enters the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials' emblem.
Deal combat damage with Phage.
Phage triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
